meta_description: Rose Legacy Decorators delivers expert interior and exterior painting across Liverpool and Merseyside. Free quotes, attention to detail, professional finish guaranteed.
hero_subhead: From feature walls to full home redecoration, we transform spaces with precision and care across Liverpool and Merseyside.
services_subhead: Whether you need a quick refresh or a total transformation, we handle interior decoration, exterior painting, wallpapering, and specialist finishes with meticulous attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Decoration
services.desc: Full room redecoration, feature walls, and colour consultation. We protect your furniture and floors, leaving your home spotless when we finish.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior finishes for fascia, soffits, doors, and rendered walls. We use quality paints designed to withstand Liverpool's climate for lasting results.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Professional hanging of patterned, textured, and plain wallpapers. Includes surface preparation and expert pattern matching for a seamless finish.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery
services.desc: Sanding, priming, and painting of skirting boards, doors, frames, and built-in furniture. Smooth, durable finishes that look freshly installed.

services.title: Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Venetian plaster, faux effects, chalk paint, and high-gloss kitchen cupboard spraying. Bespoke finishes tailored to your style and budget.

services.title: Residential Refurbishment
services.desc: Complete internal and external updates for rental properties, new builds, and family homes. Managed professionally with minimal disruption to your routine.

about_pullquote: We paint homes the way we'd paint our own — with pride and attention to every detail.
about_para_1: Rose Legacy Decorators was founded on a simple principle: decorating shouldn't mean chaos and poor workmanship. With over 15 years' experience across Liverpool and Merseyside, we've built our reputation by turning up on time, doing the job right, and treating every home with genuine care. From terraced houses in Allerton to Victorian properties in Wavertree, we know what works in this region.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen to what you want, explain our approach clearly, and deliver exactly what we promise. We're not the cheapest — we're the most reliable. Every project gets the same level of craftsmanship, whether it's a single bedroom refresh or a whole-house overhaul. That's why nine out of ten customers recommend us to their friends and neighbours.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the whole lounge redecorated — walls, woodwork, the lot. The lads were tidy, worked efficiently, and the finish is immaculate. Really pleased. Definitely having them back for the kitchen next year.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Our Victorian terrace needed some serious TLC. Rose Legacy handled the exterior paintwork and wallpapering upstairs. Professional, no faffing about, and they protected everything properly. Great communication throughout.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Got a free quote, no pressure. They explained exactly what needed doing and the price was fair. Work started on time, finished early, and they cleaned up after themselves. That's rare these days. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David M.
